items.name: Field survey + full-size room mockup
items.spec: Laser + tape survey; photograph all eight corners, door swings, booth vestibule, both raised platforms, ceiling, services, and existing gear. Tape full furniture and occupied-seat envelopes on the floor.
items.gate: Record M-01 through M-16; Greg approves the occupied mockup before custom work.

items.name: Trade drawings + approval review
items.spec: Coordinated millwork, glazing/support, lighting/power, floor-transition and acoustic details. Confirm landlord and city review required for the selected scope.
items.gate: Lead builder confirms review route and inspection points before strip-out.

items.name: Protection, removals + disposal
items.spec: Document and label retained gear; move to protected storage; protect corridor and sliders; isolate power for two main-room troffers and booth troffer. Retain doors, HVAC access and absorption pending review.
items.gate: Safe isolation and staged room closure; no blind demolition of fabric or ceiling.

items.name: Five graduated antique-mirror arches
items.spec: Current illustration proposes five 24 in wide arches at 80 / 86 / 92 / 86 / 80 in high, each with a semicircular 12 in head radius. Proposed centers are x 13.5, 43.3, 73.14, 103.0 and 132.8 in, spanning x 1.5 to 144.8 in overall. These are custom-design coordinates, not room measurements or glass cut sizes. Black smoked antique appearance with gold veining; approve an illuminated sample and field-template every shape, gap, edge and support.
items.gate: M-03 + M-12 + M-07; glazier confirms field templates, glass build-up, weight, retention, edge protection and compatible materials before fabrication.
items.source: Current full-room illustration; all custom dimensions proposed

items.name: Lit ceiling mirror inset
items.spec: Proposed 96 × 96 in visual zone, surface-applied beneath the flat ceiling. Finish to match arches; removable service access. Panel modules, thickness, backing, anchors and total weight are by the support designer.
items.gate: M-03 + M-07 + M-09 / M-10; approved overhead assembly and structural load path. Adhesive alone is not a released detail.

items.name: Compact bar carcass
items.spec: 48 in long × 26 in deep × 42 in finished counter height proposed at planning center x 13, z 160, rotation 270 degrees. The current model leaves 16.4375 in between the 48 in bar body and the 59.125 in NU1X body; this is a proposed location, not a taped fact. Black finish, serviceable fridge bay, clear front vent and accessible outlet. Zephyr candidate needs 23⅜ in body depth + 1 in rear clearance; final field layout and shop drawing control.
items.gate: M-12 / M-11; field-test the 16.4375 in modeled piano-to-bar gap, appliance cutout, open door, ventilation, cable/plug space and current occupied furniture mockup. Increase depth if the chosen fridge requires it.
items.source: Current ReferenceLayout.affordable proposal; physical envelope and fit require M-12

items.name: Black stone counter + support
items.spec: 48 × 26 in nominal top, honed black stone or approved quartz sample; eased edge. Finished counter top 42 in AFF. Template after carcass installation; fabricator details thickness, joints and supported overhangs.
items.gate: Installed carcass surveyed; refrigerator and three-stool fit resolved.

items.name: Smoked-glass bar front
items.spec: Field-sized smoked-glass infill with brushed brass trim and warm diffused backlight. Keep refrigerator ventilation and service panel clear. Specify appropriate safety glazing and retention for this location.
items.gate: Millwork shop drawing and lit glass sample approved.

items.name: Backlit bottle shelves
items.spec: 48 L × 10 D in nominal; proposed shelf tops 60 and 78 in AFF. Black finish; recessed diffused LED; hidden cable route and removable channel cover. Brackets/backing designed for bottles and glassware.
items.gate: M-12 / M-11 + M-07; backing, shelf load and bottle-height mockup approved.

items.name: Front-venting glass-door beverage fridge
items.spec: Built-in-rated narrow glass-door model, black finish; blue interior light is visual intent. Size the cabinet from the selected installation manual, including door swing and ventilation.
items.gate: Verify product cutout and depth before BAR-01 shop drawings; do not enclose a freestanding appliance.

items.gate: M-12 / M-11. A 48 in bar provides only 16 in of run per person for three seats. Confirm a workable arrangement or obtain Greg's layout decision. Sourced 17 in-body candidate needs 53 in at current centers, exceeding the 48 in bar.
